summary: Since 2.5, become_user on Windows can be the local service accounts System, NetworkService or LocalService, which need no password (ansible_become_password is ignored).
questions: Can I become SYSTEM on Windows with Ansible?
Do I need a password to become NetworkService?

answer_card.title: Becoming local service accounts
answer_card.answer_md: Since 2.5, `become_user` can be **System**, **NetworkService**, or **LocalService**. They have no password, so `ansible_become_password` isn't needed and is ignored.
